get_classifier_score.description: Probabilities that the comment is political hate speech from the fast System 1 classifiers (a fine-tuned mBERT and the zero-shot model Jev, with Jev's guess of the target and a hostility score from 0 to 4). They are fast but can be wrong, and they can disagree with each other.

lookup_political_entities.description: Finds political actors, parties, institutions, places and ethnic terms mentioned in the comment and returns who or what they are. Optionally pass one word or name to look up.

term.description: optional word or name to look up; empty = scan the comment

get_thread_context.description: Returns the comment this one replies to (if it is a reply) and up to three other comments from the same thread. Useful when the comment is short, uses pronouns, or is unclear alone.

function.name: submit_decision
function.description: Submit the final decision for the comment.
